messages:
maya: Heads-up — seeing unusual variance in eval-runner metric `gold_pass_rate` on the quant-canary. Spike started ~2h after deploy (commit 0b6f2a3). attaching job id and small log snippet.

ken: Which job? can you paste the tail of the runner log and the CI summary?

maya: job: quant-eval-4221. tail: ```
[2026-03-26T14:12:03Z] runner/metrics_adapter.go:198 WARN variance=0.112 window=0
[2026-03-26T14:12:04Z] eval/checker.go:87 INFO gold_pass_rate=0.58 expected>=0.85
```

ci-bot: CI: quant-eval-4221 failed 3/3 checks — metric-drift-check exceeded threshold (delta=0.12 > 0.05). See https://ci.redwood/internal/jobs/quant-eval-4221

oliver: that commit (0b6f2a3) is mine — I landed the async scheduler/prefetch refactor earlier to reduce tail latency. I didn't touch metric logic intentionally.

sasha: quick suspicion: the metrics adapter refactor removed the moving_avg smoothing call in the metrics pipeline during the cleanup. I remember renaming some things.

ken: can we bisect to narrow which PR removed smoothing? or pin the old adapter in the canary?

maya: started a lightweight bisect: rolling the canary back to tags v2026-03-15..v2026-03-26 to narrow. kicking off jobs now.

ci-bot: Bisect job started: bisect-uid-772 against commit range 0a9..0b6f2a3. tracking: https://ci.redwood/internal/bisects/772

maya: update: bisect indicates regression first appears when applying PR #3198 (which contains the async aggregator and a metrics rename). Repro locally: running the eval harness with the old `moving_avg(window=5)` restores stability (gold_pass_rate back to ~0.86).

oliver: ah — I swapped to an async aggregator and removed the per-call smoothing to avoid double-averaging. Bad call on my part, sorry. I'll open a hotfix that reintroduces a small smoothing window behind a config flag. ETA ~2h.

ken: product asked if we can still push the quantized model. what's the impact window?

maya: impact: noisy gating false-fails will block canary and rollout. Recommend holding rollout until hotfix validated. tagging rollout:hold and cancelling the current canary.

oliver: plan: PR +reintroduce `moving_avg(window=5)` in metrics_adapter, add `metrics_smoothing.enabled` flag default true, add unit test for variance. will run a quick canary after merge.

ken: if the hotfix is tiny we can do a hotfix + canary instead of full rollback. agree to hold until validated.

maya: also adding a gating test to eval-ci: check that for a synthetic stable input variance < 0.03 over 100 steps. Example assertion: `assert moving_avg(var_series, window=5) < 0.03` so removal is caught.

ci-bot: Issue created: #924 "eval-metrics-smoothing-gate" and scheduled nightly job `eval-metrics-gate` to land in CI next week.

sasha: :thumbsup: good call. can we add a comment in the PR to link to this thread and the bisect output?

oliver: will do. Pinging ops to pause any external canaries.

maya: thanks — will follow up with canary results in ~30m. if hotfix passes, we'll lift rollout:hold and note in release notes.

ken: thanks everyone. keeping momentum but good catch on the smoothing regression. :eyes:
